Case studies/Wild ducks
Norway · Sápmi

Wild ducks.

A collaboration between research and art

Wild ducks are one of the seven species in SPECIES, bringing research into dialogue with Sámi artistic practice.

The project overview identifies wild ducks as one of the seven species explored by SPECIES. It names Tommy Ose and Sámi artists Niillas Holmberg and Elina Waage Mikalsen as contributors.

A detailed account of this case will be shared as the collaboration develops.
